The ticket is PD-4821. I posted that as a reply to your message in #central-random.

Hollis said in #central-team on Jun 9 that the Eastbank receiving-door import for Marrow Agrisupply is attached to PD-4821. He also flagged a mismatch: the file calls the doors E1/E2, but Marrow's booking sheet calls them 01/02. He wanted that sorted before anyone reimports, so nothing gets duplicated.
